review_plan.shortfall_policy: Select all available cases when a stratum is smaller than its quota. Do not reallocate unused quota to another stratum.
review_plan.sampling_method: Text: balance the fixed stratum quota across confusion cells, then select seed-ranked cases within each cell without replacement. Images: review all 100 held-out cases per description condition. Independently seed-rank review order and A/B identity.
review_plan.interpretation: Automated reviewer judgments are evidence about the selected cases, not human truth or an unweighted estimate of population correctness. Report actual eligible/selected/reviewed counts by stratum.

comparison.other_policy: Direct agreement includes both choosing Other. Named-ID agreement divides matching named IDs by all points. ARI and pairwise scores give each Other point its own singleton label.
comparison.conditional_agreement_note: Jointly named agreement divides matching named IDs only by points named by both arms; null means no jointly named points. This conditional rate excludes rejected points and must be read with coverage and the full named/Other table.
comparison.reference_note: Per-category confusion, precision and recall are relative to the LLM assignments, not ground truth. Agreement and coverage do not establish semantic correctness.
